name: Deeper Darklight
body:
School evocation [darkness]; Level antipaladin 4 cleric/oracle 4, inquisitor 4, shaman 4

DESCRIPTION

This spell functions as the spell deeper darkness except that you and one ally per level can see through the area of darkness as if it were not active.
